summary: Tested the LABKOM landing page end-to-end on desktop and mobile. Hero, navigation, material search/category filtering, course detail and registration demo, contact demo, download feedback, links, SEO metadata, and mobile overflow all behaved correctly.

minor.issue: Backend exposes only the generic Hello World scaffold; the frontend intentionally does not use backend APIs.
Only generic status-check storage exists; no domain APIs for courses, registrations, contacts, or materials (currently expected because requested forms are localStorage demos).

action_items: If demo flows are later promoted to production, replace localStorage registration/contact/download behavior with persisted services and real files.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a large monolithic component (>700 lines); split views/data/forms into focused components before significant future expansion.
seed_data_creation: Created only browser localStorage demo entries for registration and contact testing; no backend seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core landing page flows and responsive behavior are covered. Demo submissions are localStorage-only and downloads are feedback-only as specified.
rca of the issue: No functional defects reproduced. The first automated pass used incorrect registration selectors and stopped; accessible implementation selectors were then used successfully. Registration controls lack a single modal/form test ID but individual controls are testable.
